title: Finalization Within the Call Machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $\mathrm{emit}$ be a Boolean mode, and let $x$, $\mathrm{arg}$, and $\mathrm{cap}$ be Boolean words; let $T$ be a natural number. Start the call machine on $x$ in its finalizer dispatch state, with the dispatch index at the last of $M$'s $k$ work tapes, the simulated data tapes and their heads given by the prescribed bank frame at time $T$, and the marker and origin banks as specified by that frame. After exactly $|\mathrm{arg}|+3|\mathrm{cap}|+6$ steps, the machine is in exit state $5$, with $\mathrm{arg}$ on the first work tape if $\mathrm{emit}$ is true and $\mathrm{cap}$ there otherwise, every other work tape blank, all heads at the origin, and output $\mathrm{cap}$ if $\mathrm{emit}$ is true and empty otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Boolean Turing machine with k work tapes
x, arg, and cap are Boolean words
initial configuration is the prescribed bank frame at time T with dispatch index at the last work tape
replaced:
For every mode, input, argument word $a$, capture word $c$, and time $T$: running the
clean-call controller for exactly $|a| + 3|c| + 6$ steps from the cleanup frame in which
all banks are clean (in the last cleaner-dispatch state) reaches the canonical exit seam
carrying $c$ in install mode and $a$ in emit mode, with output $c$ exactly in emit mode,
every scratch tape blank, and every head at its origin.
